Research ALL alternative approaches to controlling LLM behavior WITHOUT markup/tags in the prompt. I want to know what techniques exist beyond 'put a marker in the prompt text'. Specifically research: 1) System prompt separation — how effective is putting rules in system vs user message? 2) Structured output formats (JSON mode) as control mechanism 3) Tool/function calling with strict schemas 4) Constitutional AI / RLHF as latent control 5) Meta-prompting (model generates its own constraints) 6) Chain-of-thought with self-verification 7) Reflection/revision loops 8) Activation steering / representation engineering 9) LoRA adapters for different behaviors 10) Classifier-based guardrails (separate model checks output). For each: how does it compare to markup? Is it cheaper/more expensive? Does it work on small models? Search the web and report.
